description: Programmer additions to the global sensitive-fields list. The effective list is the union of this file and packages/schema/sensitive_fields.json. Patterns are case-insensitive regexes over field name, id, label, placeholder, autocomplete and aria-label. Role-depth additions (7 Nov 2026): database and secret fields. Commit message, pull request and review comment boxes are deliberately NOT listed: the capture never reads their text, and listing them would drop the events that make WRITE_COMMIT_MSG, OPEN_PR and ANSWER_REVIEW visible.
